title: Leaderboard table
brief: Our players want to see this week's top ten. Build the weekly leaderboard for week 46 (9 to 15 November 2026). It is a table with rank, player, score and prompts used; each player has a round avatar with their initials in a strong colour. The top three ranks get gold, silver and bronze medal-style badges, and the viewer, Jordan Ellis in seventh place, must be able to spot their own row at a glance from a soft highlight. Numbers should line up on the right so scores are easy to compare. Add a short line under the title that says fewer prompts break a tie, and a note under the table that scores reset every Monday. It should feel competitive but tidy, like a sports results page, on a light grey background.
